rows.label: qst650314_msg0001
rows.name: Is something wrong?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0002
rows.name: Special Commissioner-dono, everyone...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0003
rows.name: You know the Hanzag Wastes, right?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0004
rows.name: Yes...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0005
rows.name:
Many ferocious monsters live there.
Even the Superbian army struggles with
them.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0006
rows.name: I see.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0007
rows.name:
You want us to defeat those vicious
monsters?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0008
rows.name: No, that's not what I meant...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0009
rows.name: Could we really ask you to?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0010
rows.name: Of course!

rows.label: qst650314_msg0011
rows.name: Kamuya...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0012
rows.name: Sorry. But we can't ignore it, right?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0013
rows.name: True.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0014
rows.name:
It's a difficult place unless you're
an experienced Driver.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0015
rows.name: We'll take it.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0016
rows.name: Really? Thank you...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0017
rows.name:
As 8th Ten-Man Captain, please
defeat the Organal Leopard in the
Hanzag Wastes.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0018
rows.name: 第5十人隊隊長として ×××の○○○の討伐をお願いします

rows.label: qst650314_msg0019
rows.name:
As 1st Ten-Man Captain, may I
also ask you to defeat the Berserk
Mammut?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0021
rows.name: We've still got plenty of room.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0022
rows.name:
Then as 7th Ten-Man Captain,
please defeat the Tempest Pterus too.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0023
rows.name:
And as 3rd Ten-Man Captain,
please defeat the Salvarts Libra too.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0024
rows.name:
Finally, as 9th Ten-Man Captain,
please defeat the Grouser Angu.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0025
rows.name:
What about the 5th Ten-Man Captain's
gathering mission?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0026
rows.name: Oh, right...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0027
rows.name:
Could you also collect some
Nitrotoluite while you are at it?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0028
rows.name:
Then please handle the 2nd Decade's
Sand Salmon collection too.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0029
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] I fear my country lacks a
sense of discretion...

rows.label: qst650314_msg0030
rows.name:
So the 4th and 6th Decades
are the only ones capable of
doing their jobs, huh...?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0032
rows.name:
Erm...we haven't
overburdened you, have we?

rows.label: qst650314_msg0033
rows.name:
No problem. We'll finish it all
quickly.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0034
rows.name: Oh!

rows.label: qst650314_msg0035
rows.name:
As expected of Special
Commissioner-dono. You have dependable
Blades with you.

rows.label: qst650314_msg0036
rows.name: Yes... They're really dependable.
